resources.string: Learn how to prepare for, respond to, and recover from natural disasters in your region — through interactive lessons and simulations.
Earthquakes are sudden ground shaking caused by movement in the Earth’s crust.\n\nStay safer by securing heavy items, knowing safe spots indoors, and practicing Drop–Cover–Hold On.

Floods happen when water overflows onto land due to heavy rainfall, storm surges, or dam or river overflow.\n\nMove to higher ground, avoid walking or driving through water, and keep emergency supplies ready.
Cyclones bring strong winds, heavy rain, and storm surges.\n\nFollow official alerts, secure windows and roof items, and evacuate early if advised.
Landslides occur when soil or rock moves downhill, often after heavy rain or earthquakes.\n\nAvoid steep slopes during intense rain, watch for cracks, and move away from slide paths.
